flows:
Navigate to https://app.uniswap.org/ then Do not connect a wallet or sign anything.
On the Uniswap app, open the swap form and find the network selector for the token you want to receive (the destination side, labelled 'Buy' or 'You receive').
Click it and select a destination network from the list, such as any network shown there that differs from the source network.
Never press 'Connect wallet', 'Swap', 'Review', 'Approve' or 'Confirm Swap'.
Assert that the name of the chosen destination network is shown as text on the destination side of the swap form.
